title: Order Re-Screen Hours for Older Physician Orders — Functional Capacity Evaluation
content:
# Order re-screen hours

When the treating physician's order behind a Functional Capacity Evaluation under a Workers' Compensation Referral is old, the evaluation includes re-screen hours.

**Rule.** The order re-screen hours are two (2) where the treating physician's order on file is more than one hundred twenty (120) calendar days old, one (1) where it is ninety-one to one hundred twenty days old (more than 90 and no more than 120), and none otherwise.

The order's age is counted in calendar days from the physician order date on the referral record to the day of the request.

| Age of the physician order on file | Order re-screen hours |
|---|---|
| 0 to 90 calendar days | none |
| 91 to 120 calendar days | 1 |
| more than 120 calendar days | 2 |

## Edges

- 90 days: none. 91 days: 1 hour.
- 120 days: 1 hour. 121 days: 2 hours.
